name: Coda Video (HxGN dC3 Video)
description: Coda / HxGN dC3 Video. Two independent capability groups — video presentation/control and inbound alarm/event ingestion (ARCHITECTURE, ADR-0006) — each activatable on its own via config `enabled_capability_groups`. `coda_video` is the canonical id everywhere; "Cayuga" is a legacy display alias only (ADR-0016). MOCK adapter for now — no vendor API; the real integration is built strictly from official Coda / HxGN dC3 documentation (E16-13).
